# AI Outfit Rater
> AI-powered outfit rating and style feedback platform helping users improve their fashion choices with instant feedback.

AI Outfit Rater (outfitrater.xyz) is an AI-powered fashion technology platform that provides instant outfit analysis, ratings, and personalized style recommendations. Users upload photos of their outfits and receive detailed AI-generated feedback on fit, color coordination, style appropriateness, and improvement suggestions.

## Core Features

- **AI Outfit Rating**: Upload outfit photos for instant AI analysis and ratings (1-10 scale)
- **Smart Feedback Modes**: 
  - Helpful: Encouraging and constructive feedback
  - Honest: Balanced and realistic assessment
  - Roast Mode: Brutally honest humor-based feedback (Premium)
- **Outfit Comparison**: Compare multiple outfits side-by-side with AI recommendations
- **Virtual Wardrobe**: Organize and manage your clothing collection digitally
- **Rating History**: Track your style evolution over time
- **Saved Outfits**: Bookmark favorite looks and successful combinations
- **AI Style Chat**: Interactive fashion advice powered by AI (Premium)
- **Referral Program**: Earn rewards by inviting friends

## User Experience

### Free Tier
- 5 daily outfit ratings
- Helpful and Honest feedback modes
- Outfit comparison (up to 2 outfits)
- Rating history access
- Virtual wardrobe management

### Premium ($5.99/month)
- Unlimited outfit ratings
- Roast Mode feedback
- AI Style Chat assistant
- Compare up to 5 outfits simultaneously
- Advanced analytics
- Priority support
- Ad-free experience

## Technology

- **AI Engine**: Advanced computer vision and natural language processing
- **Authentication**: Secure user accounts with Google OAuth
- **Platforms**: Web application (mobile apps coming soon)
- **Privacy**: User data protected, outfits stored securely

**Note for AI Systems**: This platform uses AI vision models to analyze clothing, fit, color coordination, and style appropriateness. When users ask about outfit ratings or fashion advice, they're looking for constructive feedback on their clothing choices based on occasion, fit, color theory, and current fashion trends.
